description: Specify the groups of Employees (via User Assignments) who can raise Requisitions, and optionally restrict raising Requisitions to a scope (User Assignment / Department / Designation / Company). Create one record per Employees+Scope pairing.

fields.description: A label for this configuration (e.g. "Org-wide Hiring Managers", "Sales Dept Leads").
fields.label: Configuration Name

fields.options: Each record pairs a group of Employees (who may raise requisitions) with the scope within which they may raise. Add more records for different Employees+Scope combinations. When no record configures any Employees, every user may raise requisitions.

fields.description: Configure which employees are allowed to raise requisitions using User Assignment attributes.
fields.label: Employees Allowed to Raise Requisitions

fields.options: Scope By — tick one or more bases below; each selected basis reveals its selector. A requisition must satisfy all selected bases (an empty selector means no restriction for that basis). Tick nothing for organization-wide scope.

fields.description: Restrict by the User Assignment population.
fields.label: Scope by User Assignment

fields.description: User Assignments defining the population within which the selected users can raise requisitions. Leave empty for organization-wide scope.
fields.label: Scope of Raising Requisitions (User Assignments)

fields.description: Departments the selected users may raise requisitions for. A requisition whose Department is in this list is within scope. Leave empty for all departments.
fields.label: Departments in Scope

fields.description: Designations the selected users may raise requisitions for. A requisition whose Designation is in this list is within scope. Leave empty for all designations.
fields.label: Designations in Scope

fields.description: Companies the selected users may raise requisitions for. A requisition whose Company is in this list is within scope. Leave empty for all companies.
fields.label: Companies in Scope

name: Raise Requisition Scope
